e.clientX : (e.touches && e.touches[0] ? e.touches[0].clientX : 0);\n        let cy = e.clientY !== undefined ? e.clientY : (e.touches && e.touches[0] ? e.touches[0].clientY : 0);\n        let latlng = map.containerPointToLatLng([cx, cy]);\n        \n        if (delta > 0) {\n            map.setZoomAround(latlng, map.getZoom() - 1);\n        } else if (delta < 0) {\n            map.setZoomAround(latlng, map.getZoom() + 1);\n        }\n        opt.e.preventDefault();\n        opt.e.stopPropagation();\n    });"}],"TargetFile":"C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\隡箸??沔\pandapanda6666.github.io\\map\\non-existent-map\\index.html","toolAction":"Edit map zooming and shortcut","toolSummary":"Edit Map Zooming"}}]}

if(proj) {\r\n            if(!proj.comments) proj.comments = [];\r\n            proj.comments.push({\r\n                userId: currentUser.id || currentUser.uid,\r\n                userName: currentUser.username || currentUser.name || currentUser.displayName,\r\n                userAvatar: currentUser.avatar || currentUser.photoURL,\r\n                text: text,\r\n                timestamp: Date.now()\r\n            });\r\n            document.getElementById('comment-input').value = '';\r\n            syncAndSaveCloud();\r\n        }\r\n    };\r\n\r\n    initBroadcast();\r\n    initConnection();\r\n    \r\n</script>\r\n</body>\r\n</html>\r\n\n"}

50/S, top: center.y - 50/S, width: 100/S, height: 100/S, rx: rx/S, ry: rx/S, ...props });\n        canvasObj.add(rect); canvasObj.setActiveObject(rect);\n        revertToPrimaryTool();\n    };\"\"\"\ncontent = re.sub(r\"document\\.getElementById\\('btn-rect'\\)\\.onclick = \\(\\) => \\{[^}]+\\};\\n\", rect_replace + \"\\n\", content)\n\ncircle_replace = \"\"\"    document.getElementById('btn-circle').onclick = () => {\n        canvasObj.isDrawingMode = false; setActiveBtn('btn-circle'); setInteractiveMode(true);\n        const props = getProps();\n        const center = canvasObj.getVpCenter();\n        const S = map.getZoomScale(map.getZoom(), baseZoom);\n        const circle = new fabric.Circle({ left: center.x -
